🚛 Expedition Tow Rig & Trailer Architecture
Tow Vehicle: 2025 RAM 2500 Crew Cab • 6.7L Cummins Turbo Diesel (420 hp / 1,075 lb-ft)
Trailer: 16-Foot Tandem-Axle Enclosed Cargo Trailer (~40 ft combined rig)
Payload: 4 Honda Motorcycles + Gear • 60/40 Front Weight Bias (~600 lb tongue weight)
Fuel Range: 31-Gal ULSD Tank (~350 mi [563 km] safe range at 12.5 mpg) • 5.7-Gal DEF Tank
Transit Corridor: Hanmer, ON ➔ Hwy 69 ➔ Hwy 400 ➔ Queenston-Lewiston Bridge ➔ US-219 ➔ I-99 ➔ Front Royal, VA (720.3 mi [1,159.2 km] each way).
Transit Logistics Dossier ↗

📅 Expedition Master Itinerary (9 Stages) Click card to focus map
T0
Outbound Transit: Hanmer, ON to Front Royal, VA
Day 0 (Pre-Rollout)
📍 720.3 mi (1159.2 km) ⏱️ ~16.4 hrs 🚛 RAM 2500 Cummins Haul
Tow vehicle transit haul from Hanmer, ON to Front Royal, VA. Cross border at Queenston-Lewiston Bridge (CBP entry). Stage and padlock truck and 16ft cargo trailer at Eagle's Nest RV Storage.
D1
Front Royal Basecamp to Skyline Drive & Waynesboro
Day 1 (Mid-September)
📍 112.8 mi (181.5 km) ⏱️ ~3.8 hrs 🏍️ 4 Hondas On-Road
Roll out from Eagle's Nest Storage onto Skyline Drive through Shenandoah National Park. Sweep past Mary's Rock Tunnel, Skyland, and Big Meadows down to Rockfish Gap.
⛺ Primary Lodging: Charlottesville KOA Holiday
3825 Red Hill Rd, Charlottesville, VA (Near Rockfish Gap) $95 - $165 USD/night (Cabin)
Book KOA Cabin ↗ 📞 +1 434-296-9881
🏨 Fallback Hotel: The Blackburn Inn & Conf. Center $165/nt ↗
D2
Waynesboro to Peaks of Otter & Roanoke
Day 2 (Mid-September)
📍 136.2 mi (219.2 km) ⏱️ ~3.3 hrs 🏍️ 4 Hondas On-Road
Enter the Blue Ridge Parkway at Milepost 0.0. Climb past Humpback Rocks, drop to the James River Gorge (lowest elevation on Parkway at 649 ft / 198 m), and summit Peaks of Otter before arriving in Roanoke.
⛺ Primary Lodging: Lynchburg / Blue Ridge Parkway KOA Holiday
6252 Elon Rd, Monroe, VA (1.0 mi [1.6 km] off BRP MP 61.4) $85 - $155 USD/night (Cabin)
Book KOA Cabin ↗ 📞 +1 434-384-3323
🏨 Fallback Hotel: Peaks of Otter Lodge (BRP MP 86) $195/nt ↗
D3
Roanoke to Mabry Mill & Blowing Rock, NC
Day 3 (Mid-September)
📍 178.1 mi (286.6 km) ⏱️ ~5.2 hrs 🏍️ 4 Hondas On-Road
Ride past the historic Mabry Mill waterwheel for lunch, traverse the gentle rolling meadows of Doughton Park, cross the North Carolina state line, and overnight in the mountain village of Blowing Rock.
⛺ Primary Lodging: Boone KOA Holiday
123 Harmony Mountain Ln, Boone, NC (8.0 mi [12.9 km] to Blowing Rock) $95 - $175 USD/night (Cabin)
Book KOA Cabin ↗ 📞 +1 828-264-7250
🏨 Fallback Hotel: Meadowbrook Inn (Blowing Rock) $180/nt ↗
D4
Blowing Rock to Mount Mitchell & Cherokee Southern Terminus
Day 4 (Mid-September)
📍 187.6 mi (301.9 km) ⏱️ ~5.9 hrs 🏍️ 4 Hondas On-Road
The crown jewel mountain pass: sweep across Linn Cove Viaduct clinging to Grandfather Mountain, ascend to Mount Mitchell Summit (6,684 ft / 2,037 m highest point east of the Mississippi), past Craggy Gardens and Richland Balsam to Cherokee.
⛺ Primary Lodging: Cherokee / Great Smokies KOA Holiday
92 KOA Campground Rd, Cherokee, NC (BRP MP 469 Terminus) $110 - $195 USD/night (Cabin)
Book KOA Cabin ↗ 📞 +1 828-497-9711
🏨 Fallback Hotel: Harrah's Cherokee Casino Resort $189/nt ↗
D5
Cherokee to Tail of the Dragon, Cherohala Skyway & Bristol
Day 5 (Mid-September)
📍 319.3 mi (513.8 km) ⏱️ ~7.7 hrs 🏍️ 4 Hondas On-Road
Morning assault on the Tail of the Dragon (US-129: 318 curves in 11 mi [17.7 km]), climb the mile-high Cherohala Skyway, drop into Tellico Plains, and cruise northeast past Great Smoky foothills into Bristol.
⛺ Primary Lodging: Bristol / Kingsport KOA Holiday
425 Locust Grove Rd, Blountville, TN (I-81 Tri-Cities) $85 - $155 USD/night (Cabin)
Book KOA Cabin ↗ 📞 +1 423-323-7790
🏨 Fallback Hotel: The Martha Washington Inn & Spa $210/nt ↗
D6
Bristol through Back of the Dragon (VA-16) to Warm Springs
Day 6 (Mid-September)
📍 229.7 mi (369.7 km) ⏱️ ~5.8 hrs 🏍️ 4 Hondas On-Road
Tackle Virginia Route 16 'Back of the Dragon' (32 mi [51.5 km], 300+ hairpins climbing Walker, Brushy, and Clinch Mountains). Stop at the Tazewell Welcome Center, then carve east across George Washington Forest to Warm Springs.
⛺ Primary Lodging: Natural Bridge / Lexington KOA Holiday
214 Killdeer Ln, Natural Bridge, VA (Shenandoah Valley) $85 - $160 USD/night (Cabin)
Book KOA Cabin ↗ 📞 +1 540-291-2770
🏨 Fallback Hotel: The Inn at Gristmill Square (Warm Springs) $185/nt ↗
D7
Warm Springs through Highland County to Front Royal Basecamp
Day 7 (Mid-September)
📍 182.1 mi (293.0 km) ⏱️ ~6.3 hrs 🏍️ 4 Hondas On-Road
Climb north through Highland County ('Virginia's Switzerland') into Monterey, sweep east over Shenandoah Mountain, and ride the scenic Shenandoah Valley back to Eagle's Nest Storage to recover the truck and trailer.
🏕️ Staging Basecamp: Eagle's Nest RV, Boat & Vehicle Storage
3434 Guard Hill Rd, Front Royal, VA (Rig Recovery) Tow Rig Staged
Storage Facility ↗ 📞 +1 540-636-6161
⛺ Front Royal Cabin: Mountain View RV (585 KOA Dr) 📞 +1 540-636-2995
T8
Return Transit: Front Royal, VA to Hanmer, ON
Day 8 (Post-Expedition)
📍 723.5 mi (1164.3 km) ⏱️ ~16.7 hrs 🚛 RAM 2500 Cummins Haul
Return transit haul from Front Royal, VA to Hanmer, ON. Cross border at Queenston-Lewiston Bridge (CBSA entry). Grand expedition complete! 2,789.6 mi (4,489.4 km) door-to-door.

💰 Complete Itemized Financial Dossier (Per Rider • Round-Trip Model)

Per Rider: ~$1,307 USD (~$1,778 CAD) Group Total: ~$5,228 USD (~$7,110 CAD)

Tier Lodging & Dining Style Cost (USD) Cost (CAD @ 1.36) Daily Rate (USD)
Budget / Thrifty Camp cooking / instant meals / tent sites $943 USD ~$1,282 CAD ~$105 / day
⭐ Expected Tour (KOA) 8 Nights KOA Cabins + roadside smokehouses (Full Round Trip) $1,307 USD ~$1,778 CAD ~$145 / day
Comfort Hotel Individual private motel/hotel rooms + sit-down dining $1,990 USD ~$2,706 CAD ~$221 / day
🤝 Shared Fixed Expenses (Split 4 Ways) $425.50 USD / Rider
🚛 RAM 2500 Cummins Haul (Round Trip: 1,444 mi) $144.25 USD (~$196 CAD)
• Outbound Haul (720.3 mi): Ontario diesel ($118) + US diesel ($117) + 1 DEF ($18) + Lewiston bridge ($5) + PA tolls ($10) = $268 USD.
• Return Haul (723.5 mi): US diesel ($118) + Ontario diesel ($118) + 1 DEF ($18) + Lewiston bridge ($5) + tolls ($10) = $269 USD.
• Trailer Hardware Pool: 8 heavy-duty ratchet straps for 4 bikes, hitch lock, tire audit = $40 USD.
• Total Rig Round-Trip Pool: $577 USD ÷ 4 = $144.25 USD/rider.
🏕️ Eagle's Nest Trailer Staging (1 Wk) $20.00 USD (~$27 CAD)
• Front Royal, VA secure outdoor pull-through gravel staging.
• Parked Days 1–7 while 4 riders tour on motorcycles.
• Total weekly lot rate: $80 USD ÷ 4 = $20.00 USD/rider.
⛺ 8 Nights Cabins Pool (Pre-Rollout & Post-Ride) $261.25 USD (~$355 CAD)
• Night 0: Front Royal Basecamp / Mountain View ($130 ÷ 4 = $32.50)
• Night 1: Charlottesville KOA Holiday ($130 ÷ 4 = $32.50)
• Night 2: Lynchburg / BRP KOA Holiday ($120 ÷ 4 = $30.00)
• Night 3: Boone KOA Holiday ($135 ÷ 4 = $33.75)
• Night 4: Cherokee / Great Smokies KOA Holiday ($155 ÷ 4 = $38.75)
• Night 5: Bristol / Kingsport KOA Holiday ($120 ÷ 4 = $30.00)
• Night 6: Natural Bridge / Lexington KOA ($125 ÷ 4 = $31.25)
• Night 7: Front Royal Basecamp ($130 ÷ 4 = $32.50) (Post-ride rest & trailer loading)
• Total 8-night cabin pool: $1,045 USD ÷ 4 = $261.25 USD/rider.
🏍️ Individual Expenses (Direct Per Rider) $881.50 USD / Rider
🏍️ Motorcycle Fuel (87 AKI Regular Unleaded) $96.50 USD (~$131 CAD)
• Total mountain loop: 1,345.8 mi (2,165.8 km).
• Average fleet consumption: 28.8 US gal (109 L) @ ~46 mpg.
• Average 87 AKI pump price: ~$3.35 USD/gal ($0.88 USD/L).
• 100% 87 AKI Compatible: Africa Twins & Rebel 1100 require zero octane boosters.
🎟️ Skyline Drive Permit & Free Byways $30.00 USD (~$41 CAD)
• Shenandoah NP / Skyline Drive: $30.00 USD per motorcycle (7-day pass).
• 100% Free Scenic Roads: Blue Ridge Parkway ($0), Tail of the Dragon ($0), Cherohala Skyway ($0), Back of the Dragon ($0), Mt. Mitchell ($0).
🍽️ Food, Dining & Hydration (9 Full Days) $660.00 USD (~$898 CAD)
• 2 Transit Haul Days (Day 0 & Day 8): Highway diners, coffee, road meals = $50/day ($100 total).
• 7 Motorcycle Tour Days: Diner breakfast ($14), wayside smokehouse lunch ($22), craft brewery/BBQ dinner ($36), hydration ($8) = $80/day ($560 total).
🛡️ Incidentals, Frogg Toggs Buffer & Merch $95.00 USD (~$129 CAD)
• Emergency Rain Gear: Frogg Toggs Ultra-Lite2 suit at Bass Pro Bristol (~$40).
• Twisties Souvenirs: Deals Gap & Back of the Dragon stickers/shirts (~$40).
• Maintenance: Chain lube, shop towels, laundry tokens (~$15).
💡 Group Settlement Protocol: Designate a Tow Rig Captain (round-trip diesel/DEF/tolls/staging) and Lodging Coordinator (8 cabin nights) tracking via Splitwise. Settle balances with a single Interac e-Transfer in CAD upon return to Hanmer.
